During AM kennel cleaning, animal care staff radioed for assistance moving dog over to clean kennel. Worker reported that the dog would growl, lunge at kennel front, with tense body, showing teeth. When leadership went to support, dog was already on the side of the kennel that they needed to be on but due to behavior, unable to close portal door. However, when handler went to place lock through lock hole to secure the kennel, dog started to bark and lung to front of kennel door at handler with tense body, wide eyes, and showing teeth. 8/9/2026
Dog was standing in middle of kennel with an intense posture, weight shifted evenly, curling lips, growling & ears pinned back.  Handler would kennel flirt with dog while offering treats, would approach handler for treats after a few moments & started to relax body.  Opened kennel door & presented leash.  Dog would lunge forward while growling with ears pinned back again & whale eyed, handler removed leash.  Closed door & offered more treats.  Presented leash again, dog would lunge again while catching leash in mouth, biting & pulling back on leash.  Once dropped, handler would attempt to leash again, dog would keep lunging forward while biting & pulling leash.  On 4th attempt, dog would air snap towards handlers gloved hands after dropping leash from mouth, not making contact then would start to dilate pupils while standing with body weight evenly distributed, ears pinned back & growling loudly. Leash had slipped off, handler was able to slowly place second slip lead without issue. Tilted tote, dog hopped out. Handler kept hold of leash. Dog sniffed around room, approached second handler, accepted treats by hand, mouthy. Allowed some gentle petting, slight flinch, moved away. Continued walking around room. Approached for more treats. Relieved self. Second handler brought thick blanket into room, placed it on floor briefly, dog approached, began rolling on blanket, allowed more petting. Second handler was able to pick dog up with blanket, leaving face exposed. Trembled while being carried, removed leash by hand, returned to kennel. Handler left treat jackpot before exiting.
